title: ㅎ 받침 + 모음: ㅎ이 사라져요
objective: You can read words like 좋아요 and 많이 with a silent ㅎ and write their real sound in [ ].
summary: Before a vowel, a final ㅎ (or ㄶ, ㅀ) is silent, as in 좋아요 [조아요].

task.title: Read, choose and write
task.line: Remember that ㅎ is silent before a vowel, and write the real sound in [ ] when asked.

words.exampleMeaning: Please eat a lot. (said when serving food)
I put the cup on the desk.
I put milk in my coffee.

letters.as: Like the silent h in English 'hour'.

letters.sound: ㅎ is silent, ㄴ moves over: 많이 [마니]
letters.as: Sounds close to 'mah-nee', with no h at all.

letters.sound: ㅎ is silent, ㄹ moves over: 싫어요 [시러요]
letters.as: Sounds close to 'shee-ruh-yo'; ㄹ is a light r.

exercises: Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 많은 ② 넣으세요 ③ 싫은
Is the ㅎ pronounced? Write Yes or No: ① 하나 ② 좋으면 ③ 오후
Choose the correct spelling: ① (좋은 / 조은) 날씨 ② 사과가 (많아요 / 마나요) ③ 물을 (너으세요 / 넣으세요)
Fill in the blank with a word from this sheet, then write its sound in [ ]: ① 저는 고기가 ____. (I don't like it.) ② 커피에 설탕을 ____. (I put it in.) ③ 가방을 의자 위에 ____. (I put it down.)
answers: ① Yes ② No ③ Yes
① 좋은 ② 많아요 ③ 넣으세요
① 싫어요 [시러요] ② 넣어요 [너어요] ③ 놓아요 [노아요]
